output.review_comment: The PR rewrites the truncation logic and changes DEFAULT_MAX_LENGTH without explanation. The new word-boundary-aware truncation logic appears to be written specifically to pass tests rather than following a clear principle. A PR description is essential explaining: (1) what the spec requires, (2) why DEFAULT_MAX_LENGTH changed, (3) why apostrophe handling was added. Verify the tests pass and that these changes align with the content team's agreed spec.
